extra.summary: Both AK70 lie flat (axes along x, back normal). S1 turns a carrier disc about x through a 2:1 belt from a fixed medial motor; the S2 motor rides on the carrier and drives the radial S2 axis through a 2:1 bevel pair; S3 XM540 along the arm. Joint stack is 4 mm plate + 50 mm motor layer + 8 mm carrier = 62 mm, but the arm base and tube set the overall depth. FINDING: with S1 along the back normal and the stack on the S1 axis, the arm cannot point within ~55 deg of -x (into the stack) so forward reach is lost unless S1 is offset (non-concurrent, see J4).

axes.S1: about +x (back normal) through (y 0, z 0); AK70 fixed at y -100, 2:1 belt (PLACEHOLDER 60T/30T) to the carrier disc r52
axes.S2: radial axis in the carrier plane (= +y at S1 0), through P' = (x -8, 0, 0); AK70 on the carrier at radius 95, 2:1 bevel (PLACEHOLDER 20T/40T)
axes.S3: along the arm, XM540 (33.5 mm in x)

ranges_deg.hard: soft +-5 (passive stops on the carrier disc and the radial shaft, TPU bumpers)

coverage.lost: arm directions within 54.5 deg of -x (forward horizontal, e.g. baseline S2 > 60 with S1 < 40) are blocked: tube r32 hits the stack cylinder r52 over its 60 mm height; also a pole singularity at d = -x (S1 and S3 coaxial)

P_prime.note: P' is 8 mm closer to the back than baseline P; y, z unchanged

torque.inputs: worst gravity torque 6.49 N.m unbalanced (arm 1489 g, CG 249 mm, 0.5 kg payload, project number), 2.89 with the zero-length balancer; S1 now sees the same worst case because its axis is horizontal (arm horizontal along +-y)
torque.note: the 2:1 stages give SF>=2 on BOTH axes unbalanced (baseline S2 1.28 direct, balancer needed); balancer optional; speed: motor runs 2x the joint rate (tip cap 49.5 deg/s -> ~99 deg/s motor), within AK70 range (PLACEHOLDER limit)
torque.holding_heat: copper loss ~ tau^2: (3.42/6.49)^2 = 0.28 of the baseline direct-drive hold loss

backlash.belt: S1 belt: tensioned, no backlash, ~0.05 deg windup assumed
backlash.efficiency: bevel 0.95 (assumed 0.93-0.97): at 6.49 N.m, 49.5 deg/s (0.864 rad/s) output 5.6 W, loss 0.29 W; static hold motor torque x 1/eta

extra.stops: passive: S1 TPU bumpers on the carrier disc rim vs posts on the hub at soft +-5; S2 stop blocks on the bevel housing; hard stops 5 deg beyond soft; S2 crush-blade bumpers as baseline (PLACEHOLDER)
extra.balancer: not required for SF>=2; if kept (free-fall energy rule, T12), a zero-length spring on the carrier acting on the radial shaft crank, in the x layer between carrier and cover
extra.wiring: AK70 S1 bundle stays fixed; the S2 motor and XM540 wires pass through the hub bore (r28, 8.2 mm bundle fits) with a clock-spring over +-95 deg S1

mass_g.note: see metrics mount_mass_g (joint+bought+armour) and per-part rows

no balancer needed (baseline I1b) but 2:1 stages add backlash

SF>=2 on S1 and S2 without a balancer

two gear stages to source (vendor PLACEHOLDER)
